subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers require a repaired, rebased branch with live or sanctioned Feishu/CardKit proof before merge, or accept a proof override for this channel fix?
rationale: The contributor says they cannot produce a live Feishu tenant capture, while the current PR still has a concrete helper defect and ClawSweeper cannot mark helper console output plus mocked tests as sufficient real behavior proof for a user-visible Feishu change.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
options.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

options.title: Override Proof After Verification
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the proof gap if they verify the Feishu path through a sanctioned tenant or accept the channel-specific risk.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Streaming Work
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want this latest-token subcase handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.
